jobs.title: Marketing internship (brand & communication)
jobs.description: About Sarvam Sarvam is building the bedrock of Sovereign AI for India, a full-stack sovereign AI platform spanning research, models, infrastructure, and applications, with a singular focus on making AI genuinely work for India. Sarvam works with leading enterprises and public institutions and is backed by Lightspeed, Peak XV, and Khosla Ventures. We partner with India's leading brands, including Tata Capital, SBI Life, CRED, IDFC, and LIC. About the Role We are looking for a sharp, high-ownership Marketing Intern to act as the primary story-builder and content engine across Sarvam’s marketing channels. This is not a passive internship focused on surface-level social updates. You will translate complex frontier AI capabilities like our Vision APIs, Document Intelligence models, and voice platforms into crisp, high-impact stories, viral launch threads, and sharp enterprise collateral. You will sit at the intersection of product, creative execution, and creator operations, helping shape how Sarvam communicates its sovereign AI vision to technical builders, enterprise buyers, and the broader ecosystem. What You'll Do Customer Stories & Launch Comms - Transform technical milestones into narratives: Turn enterprise customer deployments into compelling case studies and written success stories. - Drive product launch comms: Draft multi-channel launch content—from sharp X/LinkedIn feature threads to enterprise mailers for prospects and existing clients. - Simplify the complex: Transla
